title: Shipping and delivery
html:
We ship houseplants, planters and home goods from 36 W Michigan Ave, Battle Creek, MI 49017 to the 48 contiguous United States.

Costs and estimates

Shipping is calculated at checkout for your address and basket, and shown before you pay. We prepare orders in 1-2 business days. After carrier pickup, transit usually takes 3-7 business days, so the estimated total from order to delivery is 4-9 business days. We prepare orders Monday to Friday. Our cut-off is 2 pm ET; later orders enter processing on the next business day.

Packing

Plants travel in a fitted sleeve and moist wrap. In cold months we may hold a shipment rather than risk frost; you will be told if that happens. Open the parcel promptly and water on arrival.

Tracking and address corrections

You can follow the shipment through the tracking link in your dispatch email. A label-created notice can appear before the carrier holds the parcel. If the address is wrong, email PumpCadle668@outlook.com immediately; once the carrier has it, changes depend on the service.

Delays and missing parcels

If we cannot ship by the promised date we will contact you by then with a revised date. You may wait or cancel for a prompt refund. If tracking stops, or shows delivery and you have no parcel, check for a carrier notice and contact PumpCadle668@outlook.com; we will investigate with the carrier and explain the resolution.

Cross-border charges

We ship within the United States, so no import duty applies. Sales tax we collect is shown at checkout.
